items.label: Profile
items.content:
Owner-operator who builds the GTM and lead-generation systems that tie marketing efforts directly to growth. With a background leading both dev and marketing teams, I know how to build heavy-duty marketing ops systems and tie them directly to attribution and sales systems.

I recently built an entire ad automation platform for a nationwide franchise with 90+ locations, and created a custom CRM/Google Ads reporting integration for a large service company. I spend most of my days moving between ad platforms, custom servers, and project management tools.

jobs.title: Founder & Operator
bullets: Run a studio building GTM, lead-generation, and marketing-automation systems for clients, owning strategy, tooling, integrations, and delivery end to end.

jobs.org: Fabutan, Canada's Largest Tanning Chain (90+ locations)
jobs.title: GTM & Marketing Systems Lead
bullets: Designed and built a custom ad-management platform that cut time to publish Meta and Google ads across 90 locations by 60%+.
Rebuilt attribution and executive reporting that tied spend to outcomes, cutting tracked acquisition cost from $72 to $22.

jobs.title: Growth & RevOps Lead
bullets: Built a custom ServiceTitan CRM integration that shifted reporting from top-of-funnel leads to booked and completed jobs, tying marketing directly to revenue.
Rebuilt Google Ads tracking and targeting, raising ROAS from 3.6x to 5.8x in 3 months.

jobs.title: GTM & Paid Advertising Lead
bullets: Built the go-to-market, PPC, and attribution framework for a B2B AI SaaS, standing up targeting and running test campaigns across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn.
Integrated the system into HubSpot and now work closely with the growth marketing team to model conversion values across the funnel.

jobs.title: GTM & Marketing Lead
bullets: Led go-to-market for a VR EdTech startup: set up the CRM, built a customer-interview system and core messaging, and helped take the team to a successful seed raise (~$1.2M valuation) in 6 months.

jobs.org: The Winston, Calgary Premium Golf Course
jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead
bullets: Built paid ad and email follow-up lead-gen funnels for $30k memberships, cutting cost per qualified lead from $640 to $343 over 6 months.

jobs.title: Growth & Automation Lead
bullets: Grew a media audience by 50,000+ followers and 30,000+ email subscribers, and built custom audience tools (including a web-based VIN decoder) to drive engagement.
